name: How long does it typically take to complete a room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on project scale, permitting turnaround, and material delivery. Typical room additions require several months from structural excavation through final interior paint. The process includes architectural drafting, municipal plan review, site excavation, foundation pouring, custom framing, exterior envelope sealing, trade rough-ins, drywall installation, and detailed trim or tile work. Working with a dedicated on-site lead ensures continuous supervision so sub-trades work smoothly alongside finish carpenters, reducing downtime between construction phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most room additions take several months, covering site excavation, framing, rough utility work, drywall, trim carpentry, and final paint.
